name: Okami Shizuka ~Ureta Kajitsu ga Ochiru Toki~
original_name: 女将・静香 ～熟れた果実が堕ちる刻～
source:
Shizuka is an innkeeper who has her husband disappear one day. One day shady man Soma comes by and declares that husband owns him a great sum of money spent on the mistress. He also bears photos with direct proof. But debt can still be repaid if Shizuka agrees to cooperate...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女将静香某天发现丈夫失踪。一天，可疑男子相马前来，宣称她的丈夫为情妇花费大笔金钱，欠下自己巨额债务。他还带着足以直接证明此事的照片。不过，只要静香同意配合，债务仍可偿还……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
